reason: Hypothesis A is grounded in cited evidence from the same alloy system showing that Nb removal (HfMoTaTiZr) reduces ductility, while Nb-containing variants (HfMoNbTaTi) maintain high strength and ductility at elevated temperatures, making the proposed Hf→Nb substitution physically sound and testable. Hypothesis B lacks supporting evidence and proposes a composition (HfMoNbTiZr) that, based on the cited subtraction study, would remove both Nb and Ta simultaneously, likely degrading properties rather than preserving them.
